page0: Can we automate to make this go faster holy wow
objective: Automate the repetitive release lifecycle for eligible same-repo MOOR feature work while preserving Funnel authority, current-main/stale-base checks, CI verification, append-only Dev Feed evidence, and optional Trajectory history.
diagnosis: Workers currently repeat stale-base checks, workflow polling, merge calls, post-merge receipt branches, receipt PRs, receipt CI polling, and receipt merges.
Those steps are deterministic orchestration work and create latency without adding design intelligence.
Authority-sensitive changes should remain manual; ordinary feature changes can safely use a bounded auto-release path.
implementation: Add a workflow_run-based trusted main-branch MOOR Auto Release workflow.
Opt in through a machine-readable PR body marker.
Reject fork, draft, non-main, malformed, or authority-sensitive PRs.
Automatically update stale eligible branches, causing CI to rerun.
Wait until Pulse recovery exists and every observed PR workflow for the head SHA is green.
Squash-merge against the exact verified head SHA.
Create the Dev Feed merge receipt directly from the trusted workflow instead of opening a second receipt PR.
Optionally create a canonical Trajectory checkpoint from PR metadata.
done_criteria: Policy parser and path gate are unit tested.
Stale branches never merge without update/recheck.
Eligible clean PRs can merge without manual polling.
Post-merge Dev Feed receipt generation requires no manual receipt branch/PR.
Workflow never executes PR-head code with write authority.
